grammar.title: Describing Things (It is + adjective / I am + adjective)
grammar.titleTranslated: Tasvirlash (It is + sifat / I am + sifat)
grammar.explanation:
Ob-havo, his-tuygʻu va narsalarni tasvirlash uchun A1 da **be + sifat** tuzilmasidan foydalanamiz:
- **It is cold.** — Sovuq. (ob-havo/narsa → It is)
- **I am happy.** — Men xursandman. (his-tuygʻu → I am)
- **The sky is blue.** — Osmon koʻk. (ot + is)
- **The sheep are white.** — Qoʻylar oq. (koʻplik → are)

Ob-havo haqida doim **It** bilan boshlaymiz: *It is hot. It is windy.*

Oʻzbek tilida «Sovuq.» deyish yetarli (ega kerak emas), inglizchada esa ega SHART: **It** is cold.

rules.note: Ob-havo va narsalar: It is cold. It is warm.

rules.pattern: I am / He is / They are + sifat
rules.note: His-tuygʻular: I am happy. He is angry.
The tree is tall. The stars are beautiful.

exercises.explanation: Toʻgʻri tartib: The + sky + is + blue.

exercises.prompt: Tuzating: It are cold in winter.

comps.title: Nature Builder
comps.passage: It is spring. The weather is warm and the sky is blue. I am happy today. I go to school with my friend. Our teacher is kind. The English lesson is fun. After school I play with my dog in the garden. At night I look at the moon and the stars. I feel happy.
comps.passageTranslated: Bahor. Havo iliq va osmon musaffo. Men bugun xursandman. Men doʻstim bilan maktabga boraman. Oʻqituvchimiz mehribon. Ingliz tili darsi qiziqarli. Maktabdan keyin bogʻda itim bilan oʻynayman. Kechasi oy va yulduzlarga qarayman. Oʻzimni xursand his qilaman.

comps.title: Listening: The Four Seasons
comps.passage: There are four seasons in a year. In spring, the weather is warm and flowers open. In summer, it is hot and the sky is blue. In autumn, the wind is strong and leaves fall. In winter, it is cold and there is snow. I like summer best. My favourite season is summer because I can swim in the river with my friends.
comps.passageTranslated: Bir yilda toʻrt fasl bor. Bahorda havo iliq va gullar ochiladi. Yozda issiq va osmon musaffo. Kuzda shamol kuchli va barglar toʻkiladi. Qishda sovuq va qor yogʻadi. Men yozni hammadan koʻproq yaxshi koʻraman. Mening sevimli faslim — yoz, chunki doʻstlarim bilan daryoda suza olaman.

comps.title: Life on a Farm
comps.passage: Aziz lives on a farm with his family. He has got a dog, two cows and many sheep. In spring, the grass is green and the weather is warm. Aziz and his dog walk to the river every morning. In the evening, he does his homework and looks at the stars in the sky.
comps.passageTranslated: Aziz oilasi bilan fermada yashaydi. Uning iti, ikkita sigiri va koʻp qoʻylari bor. Bahorda oʻt yashil va havo iliq. Aziz iti bilan har ertalab daryoga sayr qiladi. Kechqurun u uy vazifasini bajarib, osmondagi yulduzlarga qaraydi.

questions.question: Where does Aziz live?
What animals has he got?
questions.explanation: Matn: a dog, two cows and many sheep.

questions.question: What does Aziz do in the evening?

comps.title: A School Day
comps.passage: Today is a school day. Madina gets up early and looks at the sky. The weather is good — it is warm and sunny. At school, the teacher writes new words on the board. The lesson is fun. After school, Madina plays with her cat and does her homework. At night, she sees the moon and many stars. She feels happy.
comps.passageTranslated: Bugun maktab kuni. Madina erta turib, osmonga qaraydi. Ob-havo yaxshi — iliq va quyoshli. Maktabda oʻqituvchi doskaga yangi soʻzlarni yozadi. Dars qiziqarli. Maktabdan keyin Madina mushugi bilan oʻynab, uy vazifasini bajaradi. Kechasi u oy va koʻp yulduzlarni koʻradi. U oʻzini xursand his qiladi.
